Han-ah, I don't have enough words to describe how happy I feel. I've known Stray Kids since 2018, and I've grown up alongside you. Many STAYs say that you've saved us countless times, and it's true. Because of you, I didn't give up, and I'll keep fighting with everything I have because nothing should ever break us.

I've honestly been listening to your RECORD songs ever since they started coming out. There was a long period when I felt exactly the way you described in your songs, and now I feel that way again—but in a different sense. I've come back to life, and I've come back to Stray Kids.

I was away for quite a while, about two years or even more, during which I wasn't really keeping up with you, and I regret that. But I've come back to life, just like you say, and I'm so proud that you're here proving that it's possible to overcome your inner battles and even heal them through art, through amazing songs like this one.

I'm sure I'm not the only one who feels this way, but from the bottom of my heart, I want to wish all of you the very best. I hope you continue to achieve incredible success, just as you have until now. Ever since 2018, I knew Stray Kids would literally take over the world—and you did. You keep moving forward, and I hope you're proud that your dreams have come true.

From the bottom of my heart, I hope JYP lets you rest and allows you to be free and happy. Because, JYP, Stray Kids literally puts food on your table. They literally keep your company going, and yet they have to endure your poor management and bad treatment. That's incredibly unfair. They're adults now, and I truly, truly hope they do what GOT7 did. Because, JYP, you don't deserve the idols you have—you only hurt them and make them suffer.

Anyway, I'm sorry for getting so emotional, but I truly hope you all can be happy and find peace. You're the most talented K-pop group I've ever known, and every STAY is so proud of you. Be free. Feel loved. Don't let what other people say control your lives. You've already achieved your dreams, and if one day you choose to be free, STAY will always support you. Nothing lasts forever, and you've spent so many years supporting us and walking beside us.

I really hope you're all very happy. Han-ah, I'm so incredibly happy that you made it through everything. You're an inspiration to me, and I hope to see you all again in Chile. I swear that this time I'll stay up to date with everything, and I'll sing every single song, even if I don't know English or Korean.

You create nothing but art, Han, and so does Stray Kids. Please don't wear yourselves out. Get plenty of rest, and I hope Seungmin recovers soon. We miss him, but I hope he focuses on his health and well-being first.

it has been almost three years since i've been dealing with depression. I tried to overcome it in a million different ways but no matter how hard i tried, the world still felt so heavy and tiring. The reasons were multiple: my household, my family, my friends, my highschool, everyone's expectations on me... I used to be a top student when suddenly everything collapsed, every strength i had left, disappeared and i found myself alone, lost and with fear. All i could do was cry. Getting out of my bed was a torture, eating made me nauseous and even spending time with my few loved ones seemed impossible. The only thing that ever helped me was music. Music has always been there for me since i was born. It can make laugh, cry, smile... 
I remember one day i was scrolling through youtube meaningless, hoping to find something that could fix me for at least some seconds when i came across a Stray Kids music video. I had heard of them before because my younger cousin had been obsessed with them for a long time so i decided to give them a try. I´m gonna be honest, i initially didn't like it, so i stopped investigating.  I already knew some of their songs (the most famous ones) but i had no idea of the rest. 
Not long after, skz released "Do it" and i absolutely fell in love with it. I decided to give them another opportunity and i'm so glad i did. Apart from the music, YouTube started giving me recommendations like the amazing fan edits of skz. That's where i got to learn about skz as a group. I fell in love with the bond the members had and, suddenly, i found myself having actual fun watching them. Those videos, those songs started to bring a little light into my darkness. I started to listen to more music and i even developed a strong admiration for dancing. Little by little i began to find joy in the small things, even if it didn't last for long. 
I discovered stray kids at the beginning of my most difficult academical year. I cannot say that they gave me the strength to be at the top again. It was a really stressful year and my grades weren't exactly the best. But i can say proudly that i got through it and that i'm really close to finally say goodbye to this period of my life. 
I know things can´t get really good really fast, trust me, i´ve been in it three long years and i'm sure it's gonna take a while for me to fully recover. But, what i can assure is that you´ll get out. It's tough, really tough, it hurts, so much that you just want to give up on everything and disconnect from your reality. I'm not saying you have to be the best, i'm not saying you have to get your shit together, i'm not asking you to look at your reflexion an say words you don't mean. The only thing you have to do is to keep standing. No matter the storm, waterfall, hurricane, tsunami,  you keep standing. And if you fall, you get back up, don't smile, don't laugh, don't act like it's okay. Cry, let it out, but stand, don't let anyone nor anything throw you down. Stand and keep standing. For you, for me and for everyone that truly cares about you even if you can't see them. Keep standing until the day when standing no longer feels like an effort, but a necessity.

I don´t know if my story will reach someone one day and help them stand, but i know i wrote this to say one more thing:
Thank you, Stray Kids
Thank you, Han, Bang Chan, Seungmin, Hyunjin, Felix, Changbin, Lee Know, I.N
Thank you so much for helping me and STAY
Thank you for making us want to keep standing

Besides saying that it came out on my birthday and I'm super proud of it, I wanted to share a personal experience. A week after Back to Life came out, I had a high fever for 4 days and started taking antibiotics to fully recover. However, instead of making me feel better, these medications made me feel sick, with severe stomach cramps and severe dizziness. The first time I took the pill, I was on the verge of fainting because my body couldn't handle such a strong drug. I fell to the ground, but luckily I recovered. I'm still not feeling great, but every time I feel weak, I think of this song. It reminds me that one day I'll return to life and normalcy without the fear of fainting or feeling sick at any moment. Thank you, Jisung, for being with me even in the worst moments. ❤

There's a way to listen to this masterpiece on Spotify:
1) go to han back to life aka this video and click on the share button. 
2) click on the copy link option
3) now exit youtube and go to Google and search youtube converter mp3 
4) click on the first website 
5) when it opens, you'll see there's a place to paste the link. Click that and paste
6) let it scan and extract and all and after it's done you'll see a blue download button below. Click that. 
7) after it downloaded, exit and go to Spotify<profile<settings and security 
8) click on settings and security and search local audio files and click that
9) toggle it to ON (no need to if it already is)
10) then exit profile and go to library (bottom right corner) and click it
11) search local files in library and click on the playlist 
12) search for HAN back to life audio and click it
13) add it to your playlist

You can now listen to it on Spotify. Hope it helps

Hello!! Now this might seem a little random or perhaps unnecessary, but I kind of wanna talk about this song, as a hanpop-sucker. I think that I couldn't retain myself. I got really interested in rock concepts lately, but not really outside of the k/j-genre, if you know what I mean. First, I want to really tell you how much I appreciate this song, your efforts and the guts to show the world such lyrics, I can't say for sure, but I don't think it was easy at ALL. I was SHOCKED and FLABBERGASTED when I saw the video that skz had uploaded with the title HAN-"back to life" SKZ-PLAYER. You don't know how much I was filled with joy, plus seeing that it was 4+ minutes long. IT'S NOT EVEN MY BIRTHDAY!!! THANK YOU SO MUCH, ACTUALLY. Friday comebacks are usually my favorites, I don't think I need to explain that. It's like- nice, weekend now. OH WOW, A SONG I CAN THINK ABOUT FOR THE NEXT TWI DAYS, AND THAT IN PEACE!!!!🤘 I'm seriously taken aback by all those emotional elements, your naturally rock-sounding voice and especially the way those lyrics were written... By a non-native English speaker. I am not a native speaker as well, which ADDS to the impression. That's more than just impressive... It's SHOCKING AND SCARY, IF I'M BEING HONEST. It's like you possess all the talents in the world and overwhelm us with them. But I'm here for that!!!! I've been waiting to see HAN do a rock-sounding song, because I'm convinced that it complements his voice&presence the most. I'd say that I'm... Right with that? I'll have to admit that it took me awhile to get over my excitement... I even had to put my reaction to this release in words on a piece of paper dude, I was filled with joy and listened to it over and over again😭😭. Btw, this text will probably just bore anyone who reads it, but I just want to say that writing this comment was so hard for me. Not the actual writing (that too tbh), but putting it out there for strangers to read 😭. It's kind of embarrassing, but things like that make me REALLY nervous. I even wrote this down before actually typing it out.  But tbh, I feel like this is the least I can do. I'm so happy that he's happy. I think most han-stans feel this way, considering his past struggles with many mental issues- and health problems... Which is kind of natural and it really does happen to many people, for some more intense and for others less extreme. But it being natural and kinda human doesn't make the pain any less, really. Now, writing lyrics is so incredibly difficult to master... But in the end, it's worth looking at the paper! If going through all of that pain isn't enough, there you have him DESCRIBING it in a way that's incredibly difficult, and I'm not just talking about lyrics themselves but the melody, instrumentals and theatrical structure as well. They all complement each other so, so well and create all together a super beautiful, artistic masterpiece in the end, that people all around the world are allowed to witness for FREE. The least we could do is so appreciate and think about it, don't you think? We can all pick something up from this song and learn how to, possibly, express ourselves in an artistic way, if it just means thinking about how we feel our emotions and what we can do about them. So many people say that, and ME AS WELL, because I agree, but HAN, you're such an inspiration out there. To me the most important one. Seeing how people express themselves and feel about things is interesting to me and I sometimes like thinking about it, it's like learning how people are as people, and how similar or different they are from one another. I love seeing the "darker" sides of HAN, be it through songs or through looks. Actually, I prefer through songs, I don't want him going through dark things anymore... Because you never know about the outcome, until it happens. His way of feeling and showing things seem very extreme already, which kind of indicates that he's a human with a big heart, in my opinion. Having more intense emotions/feelings is difficult to manage and imo is even more of a challenge to express. I'm pretty sure that he's gone through so many slumps by now... Considering the fact that he even wrote a song named by that!! I really do feel like, breaking out of a suffocating and hard-to-manage shell, can and normally WILL make you stronger. So emotions are the most important factor when it comes to expressing yourself musically, from my view. It's beautiful to witness, but also sad to think about... When you really think about it. When you read the translations of his lyrics. But then you remember that he was able to share all of that due to him not being in that phase anymore... At least I hope so. Not only is he (probably) talking to himself/sharing his thoughts when writing lyrics, but he really IS influencing many and MANY people to hear his advices. Which DO save lives. Be it physically or mentally. The fact that he's been able to break out of these many shells so many times, is proof that everyone can do that as well, I think. It really is motivating, and I found his last song to truly be a "wake-up-call!". He is very good with facial expressions and shows us all sorts of exhausted, stressed out, nervous and hopeless scenes, wherein his face carries all sorts of emotions, if you know what I mean! I don't necessarily think that there's a perfect time or moment to release a song, people can be suffering in a few years and find the song at that time to help them out! It's probably just that many people are hurting for a longer time, which is supposedly why they believe the song arrived at the perfect time, if you ask me! But of course, there are some days worse than the others. And some people just seen to be lucky enough to have these kind of songs brought to them on a specifically unlucky day. I am really thankful for not going thru a hard time momentarily, but that might change in the future. Which I think I'll be able to survive with your songs, HAN. I seriously couldn't even listen to the first line of the song without completely crashing out. It's just THAT good. And I mean everything, from the actual sentence to the way he sang it. It's impossible to put in words, I think there are just very intense feelings you can't explain. This song is really hope-giving and I still can't get over the fact that you can share your pain/scars so freely and beautifully. Maybe freely isn't correct here, it probably took you some time and courage. But this song has so much energy and motivation to it that it's contagious. The optimism affected me and now I'm a happier human being. Hehe. Also, I don't even wanna get started about his looks in this MV, because I fear that I won't stop talking. You'll already know what I mean TwT. The acting in this MV is superior as well. Last but not least, I really wanna say thank you for all your efforts. Seriously, all of this might seem like sugarcoating, but it really is just the way I feel. And I'm pretty sure that I'm not the only one. I hope, you can take some joy out of all the compliments you get and see that you truly deserve it. No- even more than that. It's just that there's not much more I can do... I only wish the best for you and everyone who is reading this, I'm really, really excited to see what you (along with the other members of stray kids) will offer us in the future. There are so many innermost things in Jisung's songs that sometimes it feels like this dialogue is just between him and you. It's like you're sitting across from each other and pouring out what's on your mind. or you can't even connect a couple of phrases, and he smiles softly, picks up a pen and exposes your silence in the right words. It's an invaluable skill, because not everyone is capable of it. It's not enough just to sing beautifully or invent motifs that stick in your head. without sincerity and honesty, it is impossible to create something truly catchy. his songs dissolve other people's hearts and knit from them a lace of feelings that break up into notes and words. and even though in the centuries-old history, in fact, everything has already been said before him, Jisung knows how to do it in his own way, with his characteristic reverence, dedication and fierce energy. I admire how deeply and subtly he feels this world. how he moves forward, no matter what, and holds out his hand to those who stumble or cannot find the strength to continue on their way.

I want to listen to his soul on repeat, if only he would never hide it.❤

Hello!! Now this might seem a little random or perhaps unnecessary, but I kind of wanna talk about this song, as a hanpop-sucker. I think that I couldn't retain myself. I got really interested in rock concepts lately, but not really outside of the k/j-genre, if you know what I mean. First, I want to really tell you how much I appreciate this song, your efforts and the guts to show the world such lyrics, I can't say for sure, but I don't think it was easy at ALL. I was SHOCKED and FLABBERGASTED when I saw the video that skz had uploaded with the title HAN-"back to life" SKZ-PLAYER. You don't know how much I was filled with joy, plus seeing that it was 4+ minutes long. IT'S NOT EVEN MY BIRTHDAY!!! THANK YOU SO MUCH, ACTUALLY. Friday comebacks are usually my favorites, I don't think I need to explain that. It's like- nice, weekend now. OH WOW, A SONG I CAN THINK ABOUT FOR THE NEXT TWI DAYS, AND THAT IN PEACE!!!!🤘 I'm seriously taken aback by all those emotional elements, your naturally rock-sounding voice and especially the way those lyrics were written... By a non-native English speaker. I am not a native speaker as well, which ADDS to the impression. That's more than just impressive... It's SHOCKING AND SCARY, IF I'M BEING HONEST. It's like you possess all the talents in the world and overwhelm us with them. But I'm here for that!!!! I've been waiting to see HAN do a rock-sounding song, because I'm convinced that it complements his voice&presence the most. I'd say that I'm... Right with that? I'll have to admit that it took me awhile to get over my excitement... I even had to put my reaction to this release in words on a piece of paper dude, I was filled with joy and listened to it over and over again😭😭. Btw, this text will probably just bore anyone who reads it, but I just want to say that writing this comment was so hard for me. Not the actual writing (that too tbh), but putting it out there for strangers to read 😭. It's kind of embarrassing, but things like that make me REALLY nervous. I even wrote this down before actually typing it out.  But tbh, I feel like this is the least I can do. I'm so happy that he's happy. I think most han-stans feel this way, considering his past struggles with many mental issues- and health problems... Which is kind of natural and it really does happen to many people, for some more intense and for others less extreme. But it being natural and kinda human doesn't make the pain any less, really. Now, writing lyrics is so incredibly difficult to master... But in the end, it's worth looking at the paper! If going through all of that pain isn't enough, there you have him DESCRIBING it in a way that's incredibly difficult, and I'm not just talking about lyrics themselves but the melody, instrumentals and theatrical structure as well. They all complement each other so, so well and create all together a super beautiful, artistic masterpiece in the end, that people all around the world are allowed to witness for FREE. The least we could do is so appreciate and think about it, don't you think? We can all pick something up from this song and learn how to, possibly, express ourselves in an artistic way, if it just means thinking about how we feel our emotions and what we can do about them. So many people say that, and ME AS WELL, because I agree, but HAN, you're such an inspiration out there. To me the most important one. Seeing how people express themselves and feel about things is interesting to me and I sometimes like thinking about it, it's like learning how people are as people, and how similar or different they are from one another. I love seeing the "darker" sides of HAN, be it through songs or through looks. Actually, I prefer through songs, I don't want him going through dark things anymore... Because you never know about the outcome, until it happens. His way of feeling and showing things seem very extreme already, which kind of indicates that he's a human with a big heart, in my opinion. Having more intense emotions/feelings is difficult to manage and imo is even more of a challenge to express. I'm pretty sure that he's gone through so many slumps by now... Considering the fact that he even wrote a song named by that!! I really do feel like, breaking out of a suffocating and hard-to-manage shell, can and normally WILL make you stronger. So emotions are the most important factor when it comes to expressing yourself musically, from my view. It's beautiful to witness, but also sad to think about... When you really think about it. When you read the translations of his lyrics. But then you remember that he was able to share all of that due to him not being in that phase anymore... At least I hope so. Not only is he (probably) talking to himself/sharing his thoughts when writing lyrics, but he really IS influencing many and MANY people to hear his advices. Which DO save lives. Be it physically or mentally. The fact that he's been able to break out of these many shells so many times, is proof that everyone can do that as well, I think. It really is motivating, and I found his last song to truly be a "wake-up-call!". He is very good with facial expressions and shows us all sorts of exhausted, stressed out, nervous and hopeless scenes, wherein his face carries all sorts of emotions, if you know what I mean! I don't necessarily think that there's a perfect time or moment to release a song, people can be suffering in a few years and find the song at that time to help them out! It's probably just that many people are hurting for a longer time, which is supposedly why they believe the song arrived at the perfect time, if you ask me! But of course, there are some days worse than the others. And some people just seen to be lucky enough to have these kind of songs brought to them on a specifically unlucky day. I am really thankful for not going thru a hard time momentarily, but that might change in the future. Which I think I'll be able to survive with your songs, HAN. I seriously couldn't even listen to the first line of the song without completely crashing out. It's just THAT good. And I mean everything, from the actual sentence to the way he sang it. It's impossible to put in words, I think there are just very intense feelings you can't explain. This song is really hope-giving and I still can't get over the fact that you can share your pain/scars so freely and beautifully. Maybe freely isn't correct here, it probably took you some time and courage. But this song has so much energy and motivation to it that it's contagious. The optimism affected me and now I'm a happier human being. Hehe. Also, I don't even wanna get started about his looks in this MV, because I fear that I won't stop talking. You'll already know what I mean TwT. The acting in this MV is superior as well. Last but not least, I really wanna say thank you for all your efforts. Seriously, all of this might seem like sugarcoating, but it really is just the way I feel. And I'm pretty sure that I'm not the only one. I hope, you can take some joy out of all the compliments you get and see that you truly deserve it. No- even more than that. It's just that there's not much more I can do... I only wish the best for you and everyone who is reading this, I'm really, really excited to see what you (along with the other members of stray kids) will offer us in the future. ​지성아, 영상 속 모든 디테일과 감정의 변화가 소름 돋을 정도로 깊게 다가왔어. 지성이의 목소리는 평온한 안식처이자 동시에 강렬한 투쟁의 선언 같아. 지성이가 표현하는 록은 단순한 음악이 아니라, 화산처럼 터져 나오는 열정과 꺾이지 않는 힘 그 자체야.
​우리 햇살 지성아, 진실한 모습으로 우리 곁에 있어줘서 정말 고마워. 음악을 위해 보낸 수많은 밤들, 따뜻한 미소, 그리고 마음을 치유해 주는 음악들까지 전부 다 고마워. 지성이는 어둠 속에서 우리를 비춰주는 빛이고, 태양보다 더 밝은 존재야.
​부탁인데, 항상 지금처럼 다정하고 섬세하면서도 동시에 강인하고 무적 같은 지성이의 모습 그대로 남아줘. 제발 몸 잘 챙기고, 밥 잘 챙겨 먹고, 푹 쉬겠다고 약속해 줘! 우리 스테이가 항상 곁에 있다는 걸 잊지 마. 우리는 지성이의 버팀목이자 방패, 그리고 영원한 사랑이야.
​내 삶에 나타나줘서 얼마나 고마운지 말로 다 할 수가 없어. 지성이의 예술과 아름다운 영혼으로 내 상처를 치유해 줘서 고마워.

Amar o Han é como gostar de uma estrela que nunca vai cair do céu.
Ele brilha em uma distância segura, inalcançável, e mesmo assim aquece.
A voz dele chega até mim atravessando fones de ouvido, telas, traduções imperfeitas e ainda assim consegue entender partes de mim que ninguém vê.
Eu o amo nesse lugar impossível onde não há encontros, nem promessas.
Amo o jeito que ele transforma sentimentos em música, como se soubesse exatamente onde dói.
Amo o sorriso que aparece rápido e some rápido, como se fosse tímido demais para ficar.
Amo até o fato de nunca o conhecer, porque isso faz desse amor algo puro, sem cobranças, sem finais felizes inventados.
Dói saber que ele nunca vai saber meu nome. Que meus dias seguem aqui enquanto a vida dele acontece do outro lado do mundo.
Mas existe uma beleza triste nisso: ele não precisa me ver para me salvar em momentos pequenos, silenciosos, quando uma música basta.
Talvez amar assim seja aceitar a distância. Guardar o sentimento como quem guarda uma carta que nunca será enviada.
E mesmo sabendo que nunca vou vê-lo, continuo grata - porque, por algum motivo, ele esteve presente quando eu precisei, mesmo sem saber.

나는 한지성을 사랑한다.
그리고 그 말은, 그의 모든 모습을 사랑한다는 뜻이다.

환하게 웃는 모습도, 조용히 눈물짓는 모습도, 반짝이는 눈빛도, 마음 깊숙이 숨겨둔 상처들까지도.
사람들 사이에서 누구보다 찬란하게 빛나는 순간도,
어둠 속에서 홀로 버티며 힘겨워하는 순간도.

천재처럼 빛나는 모습도, 어딘가 서툴고 어리숙한 모습도.
성공의 순간도, 무너지는 순간도.
스스로를 아끼는 마음도, 끝내 스스로를 미워하게 되는 마음까지도.

내가 사랑할 수 있는 모습만이 아니라,
어쩌면 끝내 온전히 이해하지 못할 부분들까지도 나는 사랑한다.

과거의 한지성도, 지금의 한지성도, 앞으로의 한지성도.
나는 그 모든 시간을, 그 모든 모습을 사랑한다.

그가 어떤 사람이든, 어떤 모습으로 존재하든 상관없다.
그저 한지성이기에 사랑한다.

세월 속에서 어떤 모습으로 변해가더라도 그는 여전히 한지성이고,
내가 누구보다 사랑하고, 누구보다 오래 동경해온 사람이다.

나는 그가 힘든 시간을 지나 다시 back to life 하는 순간들을 사랑한다.
무너졌던 자리에서 이전보다 더 단단하고 강해진 채 돌아오는 모습을 사랑한다.

한지성은 쉽게 꺾이는 사람이 아니다.
가장 높은 곳에 서 있는 순간에도, 깊은 슬럼프 속을 지나가는 순간에도
내 믿음은 단 한 번도 흔들린 적이 없었다.

그는 언제나 다시 back to life 해낼 사람이고,
나는 언제나 그의 곁을 지킬 것이다.

그들을 사랑하게 되면서 내가 얼마나 많은 것을 얻었는지 몰라요.
그들이 없었다면, 이런 감정이 존재하는지도 몰랐을 거예요.

하지만 함께 있을 때면 모든 것을 뒤집어놓아요.
지수, 이 놀라운 곡을 줘서 고마워요.
나는 'Hold My Hand'를 온몸과 마음과 영혼으로, 소름이 끌 정도로 사랑해요.
그리고 이렇게 뭔가가 더 필요했는데, 당신이 이 놀라운 걸작을 선물해줬어요.
맙소사, 나는 한 지수 당신에게 경배를 바쳐요 🙏🏻 그저 눈물이 날 뿐이에요, 말이 안 나올 정도로 이건 그냥... 모든 걸 다 바쳤어요.

 Estás haciendo una canción del genero que te gusta escrita por vos y por un amigo cercano, tocando la guitarra en un video que expresa tu brillo y oscuridad al mismo tiempo, y tus ojitos finalmente miran con un brillo distinto.

What makes Jisung’s music so special to me is that it never feels like he’s trying to impress people — it feels like he’s revealing parts of himself little by little through every song. There’s always so much emotion hidden underneath the melodies and lyrics, and this song especially made me realize how deep and thoughtful he really is as a person.
The lyrics feel strong on the surface, but underneath there’s exhaustion, fear, loneliness, pressure, and the desperate decision to keep going anyway. That emotional layering is something Jisung does incredibly well. He doesn’t write emotions in a simple way — he writes them exactly the way they actually feel: complicated, messy, painful, but still hopeful.
Lines like “Every scar is proof I tried” hit especially hard because they feel connected to him as a person too. Jisung has always seemed like someone who carries a lot inside himself — sensitive, self-aware, emotional, hardworking — and I think his music reflects all of that beautifully. His songs don’t just sound good, they feel deeply human.
I also love the way he expresses emotions vocally. Even when the song sounds uplifting, you can still hear vulnerability in his voice, almost like he’s trying to convince himself to keep moving forward too. That sincerity is rare.
Honestly, Jisung’s biggest strength as an artist is his ability to turn his inner world into music without losing its honesty. His creativity, emotional intelligence, sensitivity, and passion are all reflected in this song, and that’s what makes his artistry feel so genuine and unforgettable to me.🤍
